title: euphrasia pectinata var. obtusiserrata
intro: Euphrasia pectinata var. obtusiserrata, commonly known as a type of marsh gentian, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in soothing respiratory issues and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia pectinata var. obtusiserrata include its ability to act as an expectorant, mucilaginous agent, and anti-inflammatory compound, making it a potential remedy for eye and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
